items.html: And then those seven lower kings descended below into the world of Beria, entirely beneath the place of Malchut of Atzilut, and their place remained vacant beneath the Sefira of Bina. And in that space between the Sefira of Bina and these seven kings, seven other Sefirot came out, included together in the image of a man comprising male and female; and this is the secret of ZON, and it is called the eighth king, whose name is Hadar, and the name of his wife Mehetabel — for Hadar is ZA and Mehetabel is the Nukva.
